signal: Moxie raised a $25M Series C led by Viewpoint Ventures and launched Scale Suite, bringing multi-provider operations and AI compliance to independent medspas.

email.body1:
Rachel, saw Moxie closed its $25M Series C and launched Scale Suite for multi-provider aesthetic practices.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Moxie off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Rachel, quick follow-up for Moxie.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Moxie needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Rachel, last bit of proof for Moxie.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Moxie's reply rate likely compares to other Series-C startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Rachel, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The fundraise-to-launch stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing is everything.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-C motion? I'll tailor it to Moxie either way.
